Where the work gets stuck

The estimate went out.
Then the day got busy.

The homeowner has a question. Your rep is at the next appointment. “I’ll follow up tomorrow” becomes next week. Meanwhile, the lead you paid for sits in a pipeline with no clear next step.

Roofline is designed to own that follow-up: find out who is still considering the roof, what’s holding them back, and who needs a conversation with your rep.

01

Work the right estimates.

Start with open, eligible quotes. Remove sold jobs, firm “no” responses, duplicates and anyone who should not be contacted.

02

Restart the conversation.

Follow up by approved text and email. AI handles agreed questions and recognises when a real person needs to take over.

03

Give your rep a useful handoff.

The homeowner’s question, original estimate and next action arrive together. Your rep reviews the roof, answers the hard questions and closes.

The 60-day estimate recovery pilot

Five real sales conversations.
Part of our fee depends on it.

Get five qualified homeowners back into a held conversation about their existing roof estimate within 60 days—or you don’t pay the final $1,500.

$1,500 to start

Plus $1,500 when the five-conversation target is met. Includes setup, the agreed follow-up campaign, reply routing and weekly reporting for the pilot.

What counts?

A unique homeowner with an eligible unsold estimate attends a substantive estimate-review conversation with your rep. A reply, a no-show or an already-active sales conversation does not count.

*Pilot eligibility and payment terms

200 eligible, contactable retail replacement estimates issued within the past 90 days; no won/lost jobs, opt-outs, duplicates, insurance-only claims or already-active sales conversations. Appropriate permission for the contact channel is required. You provide agreed sales availability, access and outcome records. The 60 days start when data, access and messaging setup are ready. Any client-caused pause must be agreed in writing.

Software and messaging are separate, pre-approved costs. The pilot is only offered if projected incremental software is $500/month or less. If five qualifying conversations have not been held by day 60, the final $1,500 is waived. The initial $1,500 and approved software costs are not refunded. No roof sales or revenue are guaranteed. No automatic renewal.

Before you book

Questions worth asking.

“Doesn’t my CRM already send follow-ups?”

It may. JobNimbus already supports automated messages. If your existing setup reliably follows up, handles replies and gets homeowners back to the right rep, you may not need this. The service is for teams that want that entire process configured, operated and measured.

“Will AI negotiate prices or promise a start date?”

No. It works from your approved information and routes pricing, financing, technical and scheduling commitments to the right person. Your team retains control of the actual sale.

“What if we don’t have 200 eligible estimates?”

This pilot is probably too large for you. We would first check whether your existing CRM can handle your volume. We won’t sell a recovery programme without enough relevant opportunities to work.

“Do you replace JobNimbus?”

No. We scope the pilot around your existing JobNimbus workflow. Access and field mapping are checked before you commit; a different CRM requires a separate scope.

“What happens after the pilot?”

Review the actual conversations, sales and costs. If continued follow-up makes sense, ongoing management is optional at $1,000/month plus approved software. There’s no automatic renewal.
